# PowerShell Download Cradle / Stager - Intent-Gated (Composite L2)

**Tactic:** Execution (TA0002) · **ATT&CK:** [T1059.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/) · [T1105](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105/)  
**Status:** ⚠️ Boundary documented (no passing implementation)  
**Data:** `DeviceProcessEvents` · **Platforms:** Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting, Microsoft Sentinel (MDE connector) · **Production lookback:** 7d  
**Rule:** [`Powershell_Intent_First_Composite.kql`](Powershell_Intent_First_Composite.kql) · **Author:** Ala Dabat

## Minimum truth

> PowerShell performs web download intent (iwr / irm / WebClient / DownloadString) with an external URL.

## Reinforcement

Obfuscation / execution (IEX, -enc, base64), suspicious parent, writable-path targeting.

## Known coverage boundaries

Documented cases where this implementation of the technique does not produce the rule's minimum truth. They run on every build and will report when a rule change closes the gap.

- **`test.yml`**: coverage boundary - encoded Empire stager: download intent hidden in -enc base64, lab C2 on RFC1918
- **`test_empire_uac_fodhelper.yml`**: coverage boundary - fodhelper UAC bypass launches the same encoded stager; download intent hidden in -enc
